reuse.why: The flag is threaded into the existing isMonthFillCategory and getSpendingFillCategories helpers that all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed once in isMonthFillCategory and a shared MonthActionOptions type replaces the repeated argument shapes; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule stays in the shared selection predicate in budget/actions.ts, where the tree keeps it.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their shared predicate and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: A single named option with a false default, documented in the predicate's comment, is easy to own and extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions go through isMonthFillCategory (directly or via getSpendingFillCategories).

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the per-action destructuring of the flag is plain parameter passing.
